tooltip.simpleblocks.suspended: Hangs in mid-air and never falls
jei.simpleblocks.info.shapecutter: Upgrade a placed stonecutter: use an axe on it (with Simple Hammers a hammer instead) while you carry 4 iron nuggets. The nuggets are used up and the stonecutter becomes a Shapecutter facing the same way.
tip.simpleblocks.shapecutter: Cuts stone and wood into stairs, slabs and more
simpleblocks.guide.page.1.title: Simple Blocks
simpleblocks.guide.page.1: The missing building blocks: Hushed Deepslate Tiles that swallow vibrations like wool, Sculk Deepslate,
simpleblocks.guide.page.2.title: Simple Blocks
simpleblocks.guide.page.2: the missing Vanilla stairs, slabs and walls, cracked and mossy bricks and the Shapecutter, which cuts stone and wood.
simpleblocks.guide.page.3.title: Shapecutter
simpleblocks.guide.page.3: The Vanilla stonecutter on a polished iron base with copper corner caps and a polished steel blade, for stone AND wood:
simpleblocks.guide.page.4.title: Shapecutter
simpleblocks.guide.page.4: it cuts everything the stonecutter cuts, plus planks, logs, wool and every other block whose stairs or slabs the stonecutter cannot make.
simpleblocks.guide.page.5.title: Hushed Deepslate Tiles
simpleblocks.guide.page.5: Deepslate tiles that swallow vibrations like wool: a Sculk Sensor or Warden does not hear a vibration that passes through the block, and walking on it makes none.
simpleblocks.guide.page.6.title: Sculk Deepslate
simpleblocks.guide.page.6: Deepslate with sculk veins. It is not generated in the world: craft it or find it in Ancient City chests.
simpleblocks.guide.page.7.title: Sculk Tiles
simpleblocks.guide.page.7: Deepslate tiles in sculk colors: each tile a little lighter or darker, a few sculk sparks breathe slowly.
simpleblocks.guide.page.8.title: Missing Stairs, Slabs and Walls
simpleblocks.guide.page.8: Stairs, slabs and walls Vanilla lacks: Calcite, Netherrack and Smooth Basalt (all three), Cut (Red) Sandstone stairs and walls, Smooth (Red) Sandstone walls.
simpleblocks.guide.page.9.title: Cracked and Mossy Bricks
simpleblocks.guide.page.9: Aged variants of Vanilla bricks that have none:
simpleblocks.guide.page.10.title: Cracked and Mossy Bricks
simpleblocks.guide.page.10: cracked Red Nether, Tuff, Mud, End Stone, Cinnabar and Sulfur bricks; mossy Tuff, Mud, End Stone, Cinnabar and Sulfur bricks, mossy Deepslate Bricks and Tiles.
simpleblocks.guide.page.11.title: Blue Nether Bricks
simpleblocks.guide.page.11: A blue counterpart to Red Nether Bricks, with stairs, slab and wall.
simpleblocks.guide.page.12.title: Natural Block Variants
simpleblocks.guide.page.12: Slabs of dirt, grass, sand and gravel, chiseled packed and blue ice, cracked ice, a nautilus shell block and froglights in three more colors.
simpleblocks.guide.page.13.title: Suspended and Levitating Sand and Gravel
simpleblocks.guide.page.13: Sand and gravel without gravity (suspended) and with reversed gravity (levitating).

quests.simpleblocks.start.welcome.title: A free guide
